In the transfer function, the bonus tokens issued to the sender are calculated based 
      on the hash of the coinbase address, block number and timestamp. The hash function used is 
      ripemd160 which is vulnerable to hash collisions. The same hash can result in different outputs, 
      leading to the sender being unable to predict the exact amount of bonus tokens they will receive. 
      This vulnerability can be exploited to manipulate the token distribution and increase the value of the token.
